name: Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp
description: Official Tapetide MCP server for the Indian stock market — 55 tools to search, screen & analyze all 8,200+ NSE and BSE stocks: live quotes, financials, technicals, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII institutional flows, option chains & IV, parsed filings, IPOs, portfolio and watchlist. Remote Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.tapetide.com/mcp` (Google OAuth or free token) or stdio via `npx tapetide-mcp`. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and any MCP client. MIT.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http tapetide https://mcp.tapetide.com/mcp

env.name: TAPETIDE_TOKEN
env.description: Personal token from https://tapetide.com/settings/tokens (stdio bridge only; the remote endpoint also accepts Google OAuth)

notes: Google OAuth with dynamic client registration on the remote endpoint
